candidate_069.name: objective-separated acquisition lanes with drift-triggered coverage floor
candidate_069.mechanism_hypothesis: When an adaptive scientific campaign simultaneously wants high-value discoveries and a generalizable model, do not collapse those objectives into one fixed weighted hybrid acquisition score. Maintain explicit acquisition lanes for exploitation, uncertainty/discriminability and coverage/random exploration; monitor held-out generalization, uncertainty and support drift; reallocate budget between lanes when the current model enters poorly supported regions. Judge hit discovery and model generalization separately, and retain a minimum coverage floor when distribution shift is plausible.

primary_evidence.source: Query Matters: How Selection Strategies Influence Active Learning in Drug Discovery, Williams, Pickett, Baxter & Palmer, Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling 66(6), published 26 Feb 2026, DOI 10.1021/acs.jcim.5c02504
primary_evidence.design: SimDMTA uses molecular docking as an assay proxy for a BRD4-BD1 scaffold campaign. A random-forest surrogate is iteratively retrained while different query strategies select batches from the same candidate pool. The study compares greedy predicted-potency methods, pure uncertainty sampling, pure random sampling, random-within-ranked-pool variants, and fixed-ratio hybrid strategies; evaluation separates internal fit, random hold-out generalization, high-affinity hold-out performance, feature diversity and hit discovery.

results.uncertainty_hit_discovery: Pure uncertainty sampling reached 37 hits among the final top 50 predicted compounds, a 74% hit rate, after 1,500 additions; greedy methods did not reach comparable enrichment.
results.generalization_vs_exploitation: Greedy MP/MPO reduced internal error while worsening performance on the random hold-out and high-affinity hold-out sets; their selected feature distributions narrowed and molecular similarity increased. Random-incorporating strategies were notably more stable across internal, hold-out and top-500 hold-out evaluation.
results.random_boundary: Pure random selection outperformed random selection constrained to the top 10% of acquisition rankings for hit-discovery behavior in the reported comparison, and expanding an RMP selection pool toward 100% random exposed underrepresented scaffold space and improved predictive generalization under the study's distribution shift.
results.fixed_hybrid_non_dominance: MP:MU hybrids at 2:8, 5:5 and 8:2 did not outperform dedicated uncertainty sampling; the hybrid feature distributions remained more similar to greedy MP than to MU. RMP:RMU hybrids showed no significant predictive-accuracy advantage over single random-incorporating strategies and only modest hit improvements with no consistent relationship to the mixing ratio.

primary_evidence.interpretation: This is direct science-domain evidence that a fixed scalar or fixed-ratio exploration/exploitation mixture can inherit the failure mode of one objective rather than deliver both. The safer control hypothesis is to keep discovery and coverage/generalization as separately observed obligations and reallocate lane budget using drift/support diagnostics instead of assuming one static mixture is Pareto-improving.
primary_evidence.limits: The campaign is in silico, uses docking score as a biological-assay proxy, covers one protein target and a constrained scaffold space, and is not an LLM scientist. The study does not test a dynamically reallocated lane controller. Therefore candidate_069 is a mechanism hypothesis supported by acquisition-policy ablations, not a demonstrated autonomous-scientist architecture.

corroborating_evidence.source: Active Learning for Generalizable Detonation Performance Prediction of Energetic Materials, Ullberg et al., Chemistry of Materials 38(13), published online 30 Jun 2026, DOI 10.1021/acs.chemmater.6c01049
corroborating_evidence.result: An expected-improvement active-learning loop repeatedly entered new chemistry. The Gen-0 model's Kamlet-Jacobs MAE rose from 112 m/s in-sample to 399 m/s on newly selected Gen-1 chemistry, while CHEETAH MAE rose 173 to 683 m/s. After adding new chemistry, out-of-sample error improved through Gens. 2-3 to minima of 177 and 206 m/s; a chemically disjoint Gen-4 batch caused another spike to 730 and 2105 m/s, then retraining recovered to 267 and 275 m/s.
corroborating_evidence.scope: This supports explicit support-drift monitoring and competence recalibration when acquisition deliberately crosses into novel regions. It does not compare random, uncertainty and fixed hybrids, so it is corroborating boundary evidence rather than direct evidence for the lane-arbitration mechanism.

candidate_069.relation_to_existing: candidate_068 established a coverage-preserving reserve against theory-conditioned sampling lock-in. candidate_069 narrows the unresolved controller design: a naive fixed hybrid is not enough. Coverage/generalization and high-value discovery should remain separately measured acquisition obligations, with lane allocation changed by observed distribution shift and competence rather than a permanent blend ratio.
